parts.text: I'm planning a trip. What is the current weather in Tokyo, Japan? Based on the weather conditions, should I pack an umbrella or sunscreen? Use the get_weather tool to check before answering.

You are a weather assistant. You have access to a get_weather tool. You must call the get_weather tool for any weather question and never guess weather data. After receiving the tool result, provide a concise summary of the weather.

functionDeclarations.description: Get the current weather for a city. Must be called for weather questions.
functionDeclarations.name: get_weather

city.description: City name to get weather for
